text:
Alex: Quick question — embeddings API: what's our policy for non-string inputs, empty/null items, and per-item truncation when batching? I couldn't find this in the public spec.
Marie: Good call. Current informal behaviour in runtime: coerce primitives to strings, JSON.stringify objects, treat null as empty string. But that's not codified anywhere.
Ian: That's right, but we haven't decided what to *return* for empty strings. Last convo leaned toward returning a normal embedding for empty string (not an error) so indexes align with inputs.
Sam: I'd prefer explicit behaviour: 1) Accept strings & arrays of tokens. 2) Coerce numbers/booleans -> toString(). 3) Objects -> JSON.stringify(). 4) null -> "". 5) Empty string -> produce embedding for empty input (not zero vector).
Alex: What about truncation? Do we return per-item truncated input or raise an item-level error? Also batch size limits — do we count tokens or characters?
Marie: Runtime truncates each item to model max_length (token-based) using byte-preserving unicode split + tokenizer, then runs embed. We don't raise item errors for truncation — we silently truncate currently.
Ian: Silent truncation caused a bug for one customer. Suggest we surface a warning header or per-item metadata in response about truncation.
Sam: API backward compatibility: adding per-item metadata is ok if optional. Could add `warnings` array per item: e.g., {"index":2,"code":"truncated","details":"input tokenized to X, truncated to Y"}.
Alex: Proposed response format (backwards-compatible): keep top-level `data` array of vectors in same order. Add optional `meta` object with `item_warnings` (array) and `model_dim`.
Alex: Example request:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-1",
  "input": ["hello", "", null, 123, {"text":"nested"}]
}
```
Marie: Example response suggestion:
```
{
  "model":"rwd-embed-1",
  "model_dim":1024,
  "data":[
    {"embedding":[0.012,...]},
    {"embedding":[0.000,...]},
    {"embedding":[0.000,...]},
    {"embedding":[0.034,...]},
    {"embedding":[0.056,...]}
  ],
  "meta":{
    "item_warnings":[{"index":3,"code":"coerced_to_string","message":"number converted to string"},{"index":4,"code":"object_stringified","message":"object JSON-stringified"}],
    "truncation_summary":"2 items truncated"
  }
}
```
Ian: Important: keep `data` length == input length so client-side mapping is trivial. No dedupe or reordering.
Sam: Batch limits: count tokens across the whole batch for model capacity; reject batch if total tokens > 200k (example). Also enforce max items per batch (e.g., 2048 items). Add clear 413/422 errors.
Marie: I'll open a spec PR with these proposals + example test vectors. prod-bot: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5678 :tada:
Alex: Thanks — can we land tests in runtime and add API client tests for empty/null/number/object cases? I'll queue a review.
Sam: I'll add unit tests for truncation warnings + integration tests to verify order/length.
Marie: Awesome, updating docs after PR merges. :rocket:
prod-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging 2025-05-12T03:00Z
Alex: Great, closing this thread for now. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
